levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: An ancient cat whose name no one knows. He carries a staff worn smooth from decades of use. His aura of blessing strengthens allies within 5 tiles \u2014 slow to move, impossible to rattle.

levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: He has seen worse. The Elder's blessing now reaches 7 tiles and deepens for every ally within range. He does not hurry. The battle comes to him.

levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: At his strongest the Elder's aura fills the entire field (8 tiles). Those who stand in it do not merely fight harder \u2014 they endure.

levels.name: Heavy Ballista

levels.name: Catapult

levels.name: Grand Trebuchet

levels.name: Grand Grimalkin
levels.description: Tower-tall, moss-grown and rune-scored. The Grimalkin at full power - when mana fills it unleashes Stone Smash, slamming the ground to damage and knock back all enemies in a 2-tile radius. Looming Presence now reaches 4 tiles.
